lines.zh: 我半个身子在水里，慢慢划。
lines.en: Half submerged, I paddle slowly.

lines.zh: 鳍膜一开一合，推着水走。
lines.en: My fin membranes open and close, pushing water.
I swim along the riverbed.

lines.zh: 背脊那一排硬棘支棱着。
lines.en: The hard spines along my back stand up.
I round a sunken log without muddying the water.
My tendrils feel the way.
I haul out and wet the whole bank.

lines.zh: 骨头外面包着一层薄膜。
lines.en: Thin film wraps my bones.

lines.zh: 我拖着身子挪到另一个池。
lines.en: I drag myself to another pool.

lines.zh: 每一步都有水被挤出来。
lines.en: Water squeezes out with each step.
I smell blood and change course.

lines.zh: 我游得慢，可从不改主意。
lines.en: I swim slowly, but never change my mind.
My fins leave ripples behind.

lines.zh: 我压着水面走，几乎不出声。
lines.en: I move along the surface, nearly silent.
Weeds snag me; I tear free.
I head toward the warmer water.
I hang in the water, gills working slowly.
My tendrils curl by my mouth.
Something is nibbling my fin.

lines.zh: 我的触须在水里慢慢张开。
lines.en: My tendrils slowly open in the water.
A rhythm ticks inside my bones.
A film of tissue drifts off me.
I open my mouth; no sound.
The sand below is cold.
I stare at the light on the surface.
I sink a little deeper.
My skin slowly changes colour.
A school of small fish circles me.
I stop, and the ripples stop too.
Something walks on the bank.

lines.zh: 你的靴尖离水，只差一格。
lines.en: Your boot tip is one block from the water.
I lift my head; the surface breaks.
You need air; I don't.
I count how many steps you take back.
Your boots are already wet.

lines.zh: 我往前一送，水就到了你脚边。
lines.en: I push forward and the water reaches your feet.

lines.zh: 你的心跳在这水里很清楚。
lines.en: Your heartbeat carries well underwater.

lines.zh: 你的手一伸进来，我就咬。
lines.en: Put your hand in, and I bite.

lines.zh: 你上次来过，我记得你的血味。
lines.en: You came before; I remember the taste of your blood.
This river is mine.
I curl and my gills shut.
The water spreads my blood.
I sink a little, then rise.
That hit my membrane.
I make a low bubbling sound.
Half my fin has torn.
I retreat to deep water to recover.
It hurts, but no one sees it underwater.
You broke my rhythm.
I watch you and don't sink away.
Blood; very fresh.
Drop it down here.
I smell fish.
I come close and the surface ripples.
Not enough of it.
I open my mouth, then close it.
Don't hand it over; I won't be gentle.

lines.zh: 食物一到水边，就归我了。
lines.en: Once food reaches the water's edge, it is mine.
It's fish; I can tell.

lines.zh: 你手里的鱼，只够我尝个味。
lines.en: The fish in your hand is barely a taste.
You run into me and water sprays.

lines.zh: 你抓上来，只抓下一手黏液。
lines.en: You grab at me and come away with a fistful of slime.
I shift aside and the ripples spread.
Our bodies meet with a dull thud.
You've stepped into my water.
I slide past you.
The water pulls me down.
My fin scrapes your leg.
This bank is too narrow.
I slide a body-length away and press back in.

lines.zh: 水里有一股同类的味道。
lines.en: There's the scent of my kind in the water.
We circle each other.
Our tendrils touch, lightly.
I stop above her.
The eggs will settle in the weeds.
She's wounded; I nudge her gently.
We sink to the bottom side by side.

lines.zh: 水把我们两个包在一起。
lines.en: The water holds us both.
She rests her head against my fin.
This bend of the river will do.
I take the meat in my jaws.
What's on the bottom, I collect.
It's heavy; I don't mind.

lines.zh: 我用触须压住，等它不动。
lines.en: I pin it with a tendril and wait for it to stop moving.
A mineral smell.

lines.zh: 我卷着它，游过一整片礁。
lines.en: I coil around it and swim past a whole reef.

lines.zh: 亮的东西在深水里很显眼。
lines.en: Bright things show in deep water.

lines.zh: 我一口吸进去，连水一起。
lines.en: I draw it in with a gulp of water.
This one isn't food.
I curl a tendril around it.
The water's smell has changed.
I turn; my gills flare.
Ripples at the far bend.
I press along the riverbed.

lines.zh: 水里有铁味，是从你身上来的。
lines.en: There is iron in the water, and it comes from you.
The spines on my back lift.
I know where I'll bite.
It faces away, its gills still working.
The water's murky; good.
This will come suddenly.
I follow underwater without pause.

lines.zh: 它在岸上跑，我走水里的路。
lines.en: It runs on land; I take the water route.
The distance stays short.
I skim the muddy bottom.
It looks back; I sink.
I wait for it to enter the water.
My fins spread wider.
Water splashes at its feet.
It retreats to the shallows; good.
One more step is enough.
I clamp its leg.
My tail slaps and a wall of water hits.
I coil around it and sink toward the dark.
Bone knocks bone, loudly.
It kicks and breaks free.
My spines open its hide.
The river runs red with blood.
I fling it onto the bank.
It can't breathe; I know.
My teeth sink into its flesh again.
The surface bulges.
I rise out of the water.
A fishy smell fills the bend.
The weeds break under me.
My back spines break the surface first.

lines.zh: 水从我的骨缝里流下去。
lines.en: Water runs out of my joints.
These waters didn't hold me before.
I gape and draw in water.
Everything on the bank backs away.
I drop into the shallows and mud churns.

lines.zh: 火在水面烧，我的皮收紧了。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface; my hide tightens.

lines.zh: 我摔在干地上，鳃里进了沙。
lines.en: I land on dry ground; sand gets in my gills.

lines.zh: 水太深，我居然也喘不上。
lines.en: Even I can't draw breath at this depth.

lines.zh: 冲击在水里推得我翻滚。
lines.en: The blast rolls me through the water.
A harpoon sticks in my back.
The water suddenly stops obeying me.
Empty for long, my body hollows.

lines.zh: 雷顺着水传过来，我全身一僵。
lines.en: Lightning travels through the water; I go rigid.
The water is gone; I keep falling.
